interactions.title: Payments ops — Razorpay settlement and webhooks

messages.content: Karthik, Ananya — this thread is for settlement and webhook questions that overlap both engagements. Project files stay in each project.

Happy to share the webhook idempotency notes. Duplicate payment refunds are the case we keep hitting on settlement day.
I'll post the shared retry checklist here after tomorrow's reconciliation review. Production changes still go through each project milestone.
